hypothesis: The listener has learned an implicit Quran sequence prior from Quran-only training text, so it under-emits speech that does not continue the expected verse, such as words inserted at an ayah start or a name swapped in a refrain. Fine-tuning on spliced 'unfaithful' recitation with corrected transcripts and no new channel augmentation should fix this; predict listener -5 and overall -4, mostly from the 13 added-word misses.
